name: Strezzy’s Apps
subtitle: Your iPhone apps, together.
description: Music, VoiceGlass, Prism, Moonhop, and future apps from Strezzy. Refresh this source for the latest published builds.

apps.name: Music
apps.subtitle: Your music. Offline.
apps.localizedDescription: A native offline music player with songs, albums, playlists, local search, editable artwork, and Liquid Glass controls. Version 0.10 adds all 15 Cask 3 scrolling presets in Settings.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial catalog release: Music 0.10 (11), VoiceGlass 1.0 (1), Prism 1.0 (1), and Moonhop 1.0 (1).

apps.versionDescription: Initial catalog release: Music 0.10 (11), VoiceGlass 1.0 (1), Prism 1.0 (1), and Moonhop 1.0 (1).

apps.name: VoiceGlass
apps.subtitle: Create with your voice. On your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Native on-device voice cloning and text-to-speech, reference recording/import, saved voices and clips, playback and WAV export. Download compatible Core ML models once, then create locally. Built device IPA; physical-iPhone inference validation is still required.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial catalog release: Music 0.10 (11), VoiceGlass 1.0 (1), Prism 1.0 (1), and Moonhop 1.0 (1).

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Record a short voice sample on this iPhone.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Transcribe your voice sample on this iPhone so Qwen can match your voice. VoiceGlass requires on-device recognition; audio is not sent to a server.

apps.name: Prism
apps.subtitle: Your imagination. On your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Native AI image generation and reference-image editing with Generate, Edit, Gallery and Settings tabs. FLUX.2 Klein and Z-Image Turbo run through MLX and Metal with separately downloaded models. Built device IPA; physical-iPhone inference validation is still required.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial catalog release: Music 0.10 (11), VoiceGlass 1.0 (1), Prism 1.0 (1), and Moonhop 1.0 (1).

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save the images you create in Prism to your photo library.

apps.localizedDescription: An offline landscape pixel-art platformer with touch controls, jumping, checkpoints, collectibles, and a moonlit world.
